articles.text: BÁI NǙSHÌ: Zhāng Xiānsheng ma? Wǒ yǒu yíjiàn shì xiǎng gēn nín dǎting dǎting.
MISS WHITE: Is this Mr. Zhāng? I have something I'd like to ask you about.
BÁI NǙSHÌ: Tīngshuō nín nàbian xīn láile yíwèi Fāng Xiānsheng. Tāde míngzi wǒ wàngji le.
MISS WHITE: I heard that a Mr. Fāng recently joined your office. I've forgotten his given name.
ZHĀNG XIĀNSHENG: Bú cuò, Fāng Démíng shi shàngge lǐbài pài dào wǒmen zhèli láide. Nǐ rènshi ta ma?
MR. ZHĀNG: That's right. Fāng Démíng was sent here last week. Do you know him?
BÁI NǙSHÌ: Bú rènshi. Búguò tīngshuō tā yě shi Jiāzhōu Dàxué bìyède.
MISS WHITE: No. But I heard he also graduated from the University of California.
ZHĀNG XIĀNSHENG: Méi wèntí. Nǐ xiànzài néng lái ma?
MR. ZHĀNG: No problem. Can you come now?
BÁI NǙSHÌ: Xíng. Chàbuduō bànge zhōngtóu jiù dào.
MISS WHITE: That's fine. I'll be there in about half an hour.
